title: Balanced Ham Sandwich Line
primary_problem: Green, 100 Open Problems, Problem 75 in the retrieved author-hosted PDF
intended_domain: Finite sets of n >= 2 distinct points in the real affine plane; arbitrary collinearities; straight determined lines; open-half-plane counts
proved_partial: For each exposed vertex p, a determined line through p has discrepancy at most m_p - 2 + (n mod 2), where m_p is maximum collinearity through p. Centrally symmetric configurations have minimum discrepancy 0.
known_general_bound: O(log log n), credited to Pinchasi; no explicit numerical constant extracted
source_correction: Primary evidence establishes examples with minimum discrepancy 2, ruling out universal bound 1. It does not support the survey sentence ruling out bound 2.
remaining_target: Prove discrepancy <= 100 for all intended configurations, or construct one whose every determined line has discrepancy >= 101.
